# F1Zone

> F1Zone is an unofficial demo poster shop with invented race liveries, helmets and circuits, search, filters and a browser-side cart, built with HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Nothing here is for sale.

## Pages

- [Home](https://f1.dawidolko.pl/): Poster collections, bestsellers, product search and contact details.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/dawidolko/F1Zone-Project-HTML-CSS-JS-SASS): Source code and setup notes for the project.
- [Credits](https://github.com/dawidolko/F1Zone-Project-HTML-CSS-JS-SASS/blob/main/CREDITS.md): Assets, authors and licences.
